Every agent in the system doubles as a **sensor**: when work exposes friction —
a workaround written for an awkward tool, a misleading doc, a failure that
fought back past a few attempts, a degradation signal — the agent files it the
moment it's noticed, instead of letting it evaporate into conversation prose.

## The capture verb

`improvements:capture { kind, title, detail?, paths?, rubricRef?, ratings? }`

- **`kind`/lane** routes it: `observation` (a sensor reading — the default
  reflex, on in every mode) vs `feature` (a reviewed proposal for net-new
  capability — the [IDEATE](/internal/docs/agents/session-modes) lane).
- Evidence-bearing signal only — a genuine, repeatable friction the next agent
  would also hit; not one-off slips. Sparseness keeps the queue clean.
- When a ratified rubric covers what was just measured, captures carry
  `rubricRef` + `ratings` with concrete evidence — see
  [rubrics and scorecards](/internal/docs/system/rubrics-scorecards).

Captures land as rows in the engineer-issues store (kind-tagged, lane-tagged,
`EI-NNN` ids) scoped to the papercusp workspace itself; problems in a *managed*
harness are `work_items:create` instead.

## Downstream: who reads them

- **`improvements:digest`** — the triage surface: dedupe, rank, promote to
  real work items, close the stale.
- **The Learning tab** (GUI) — the owner's pull surface for the workspace-wide
  improvement backlog; it replaced push notifications by design.
- **The scout/mug ideation loop** — observations are the corpus
  `curation:state-of-pot` synthesizes and scouts mine for the pattern behind
  several frictions; graded proposals flow back via `scout:grade-idea`.
- **The watchdog** — the automated sibling: tool-error clustering files the
  objective signals (`improvements:watchdog-status` shows its state), while
  capture carries the subjective ones.

## The completion-time reflect

Completing a work item prompts a one-time reflect: did tooling friction, lock
contention, or a validation/review bounce bite during this unit of work? If
genuinely repeatable, capture it then — that prompt is the pipeline's main
intake point, deliberately placed at the moment the friction is freshest.

## Why it matters

This pipeline is the input side of
[knowledge packs](/internal/docs/system/knowledge-packs) and the
[scout loop](/internal/docs/system/scout-loop): the system's self-improvement
is only as good as what its agents bother to file. Dogfooding makes it real —
the builders live inside the product, so the queue fills with lived friction,
not speculation.
